scope.target: Normal linear and merge-commit topology selection plus successor-release gating.
constraints: Linear merge is a normal positive rule, not an exception.
Pull-request need and Git topology are independent decisions.
Do not invent the next release version.
non_goals: Allocating a successor version without a separate owner decision.

steps: Define positive selection rules for linear and merge-commit integration.
Classify historical README-only updates as PR-reviewed linear candidates by default.
Register GOV-004 and its next-successor-release activation gate.
Validate and integrate this branch using the selected linear topology.
validation: Run backlog, provider, workflow, and commit validators.
Verify hosted checks and linear main ancestry.
execution.last_completed_step: Implemented positive linear and merge-commit rules, README classification, PR template evidence, and unassigned successor-release gating.
execution.next_action: Independent verification checks WFG-003, then the PR uses the selected linear topology.

results.summary: Linear and merge-commit integration are now positive normal choices independent of execution mode and PR gating; historical README-only updates default to direct mode, PR review, and linear topology; GOV-004 is gated into the next owner-allocated successor release without inventing its version.
results.residual_risk: Provider branch-protection configuration may limit available topology mechanisms; target policy remains authoritative.
